$comment: Tempdoc 814 D5 — One authority, one pointer. A status fact (capability degradation, budget state, source count) has exactly one persistent-chrome authority surface at the pinned viewport; every other appearance is a pointer to the authority or absent. This register names the phrase-level surface of that rule: each entry is a literal phrase the measurement probe (scripts/jseval/jseval/ui_measure.py capture_measure -> statusFacts) counts across the shadow-piercing deep DOM text of a capture. `maxPersistentRenders` is the ceiling `jseval ui-proportion-gate` enforces on any step that opts in via `statusFactsSingleton: true` (governance/ui-proportion-baseline.v1.json) — a count above the ceiling is the copy-lint the D5 charter asked for, not eyeballed. See docs/tempdocs/814-chat-surface-chrome-allocation.md §D5 / §D7.3.
